high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for a discussion or event titled "Aliens, Space & Consciousness." The background features a cosmic theme with a depiction of an alien face with glowing blue eyes, set against a backdrop of stars and a planet resembling Earth. The alien's hand is prominently displayed, holding the Earth. On the left side of the image, there is a woman wearing a blue NASA flight suit with an American flag patch on her sleeve. She has long dark hair and is smiling, giving a sense of confidence and professionalism.
